snippet.title: Eternal Remnant: The First Chapter - Indie Quest Trailer
snippet.description:
➡️Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946380/Eternal_Remnant_The_First_Chapter/
➡️ itch.io: https://arcfinder-studios.itch.io/eternal-remnant

Join two siblings and a rogue outcast as they brave an unfamiliar world, hunted for a deadly secret they carry. Help Arin and Vera fight for their lives in this upcoming retro-inspired RPG!

Follow us on Twitter / X, Bluesky, and join our Discord server!
